decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the northern and southern walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm  on Mondays to Friday and 9am to 1pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 6 - REASON FOR APPROVAL.

It is considered that this application for first floor extension to the school, because of its position, design and appearance, would be acceptable having regard for the site characteristics of Longford Community School, Tachbrook Road, and would not be detrimental to the appearance of the original school building and the character of the street scene, to the amenities of the residential properties along Cassiobury Avenue due to the distance from the extension. On balance, the development is in accordance with the Adopted UDP policies ENVB.1.1 (All Development); C.2.1 (Educational Facilities) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments).
